shortDescription: Resource module for Compliance Policys Rules

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: description
options.description: A comprehensive description of the rule. This should provide detailed information about what the rule does, its scope, and any other pertinent details that explain its function and purpose.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The `id` of the rule within the compliance policy.

options.name: impact
options.description: This describes the potential impact when the conditions of this rule are violated.

options.name: name
options.description: This is the name of the rule. It should be a concise and descriptive title that clearly identifies the rule's purpose or function. The name must be unique within the specified policy.

options.name: policyId
options.description: PolicyId path parameter. The `id` of the compliance policy.

options.name: softwareType
options.description: Specifies the software type applicable to the rule. For detailed enum descriptions, refer to the `Features` tab.

options.name: suggestedFix
options.description: Suggestions on how to fix the issues detected by this rule.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
